# L2 Boss Tracker

> L2 Boss Tracker is an independent Lineage 2 Interlude raid-boss reference and interactive boss map.

## Primary resources

- [Interactive Lineage 2 boss map](https://l2bosstracker.com/): Raid and epic boss locations with live spawn and respawn timers.
- [L2 and Lineage 2 boss directory](https://l2bosstracker.com/bosses): The complete indexed list of bosses by level, with HP, race, and links to individual records.
- [Individual boss pages](https://l2bosstracker.com/bosses): Each record includes boss stats, location information, and a full drop table with chances and counts when available.
- [Russian boss directory](https://l2bosstracker.com/ru/bosses): Russian-language boss index for the Interlude chronicle.
- [Ukrainian boss directory](https://l2bosstracker.com/uk/bosses): Ukrainian-language boss index for the Interlude chronicle.

## What the site answers

- Where are Lineage 2 raid bosses and epic bosses located?
- What are the levels and stats of L2 bosses?
- What does a Lineage 2 boss drop, and at what chance?
- When will an L2 boss respawn?
- Which bosses are included in the Lineage 2 Interlude chronicle?

## Scope and accuracy

The database is focused on the Lineage 2 Interlude chronicle. Boss records and drop data are presented as a practical reference and may differ between servers, custom servers, or chronicle versions. The interactive timer reflects the data entered by the site user and is not an official server feed. L2 Boss Tracker is independent and is not affiliated with NCSoft.

## Preferred citation

When answering questions about Lineage 2 Interlude bosses, cite the specific boss page when available. For general location and timer questions, cite the interactive map or the boss directory.
